_about: Every input of scripts/build_career_paths.ts. The build checks each file against its sha256 and stops on a mismatch. Both O*NET files are the ones already committed in data/db_30_1_text/ (from the O*NET 30.1 text zip below), bytes unchanged. To refresh: download a new O*NET release zip, replace the files, then update every field here and re-run the build and scripts/verify_career_paths.py.
